summary.intent: Close out the final ticket (#48, deployment/infra/release blueprint) on the cipher-box-next wayfinder map, then plan and begin executing the v1-freeze/v2-cutover steps in the actual cipher-box repo.
summary.outcome: Wrote and merged blueprint/deploy.md (PR 55), closed ticket #48 and the wayfinder map itself (all 16 specs/7 blueprints complete); then executed Steps 0-1 of the freeze plan in cipher-box: created v1 branch + v1-freeze tag at the last released commit (07376d0b), closed the stale release-please PR unmerged, deleted the v1-only release-automation workflows/scripts, rewrote release-please.yml for single-component versioning, added root rust-toolchain.toml and node engines pinning, and cleaned stale references in CLAUDE.md/DEPLOYMENT.md/zizmor.yml (first handover commit made; more to follow).

repo: cipher-box CI/CD has 16 GitHub workflows with a workflow_call chain (ci-e2e.yml → web-e2e.yml/desktop-e2e.yml; tag-staging.yml → web-e2e/desktop-e2e/deploy-staging.yml); release-gate.yml doesn't run E2E itself, it polls ci-e2e.yml's main runs.

release-please runs in aggregated multi-component mode (16 components, separate-pull-requests:false) with a load-bearing 'chore(release): set release targets for PR #N' bot commit from pr-release-preview.yml — force-pushing over it silently drops version bumps.

Cargo.lock sync is two-tier (pre-merge cargo-lock-release-sync.yml on the release PR branch, post-merge fallback inside release-please.yml) because release-please's native cargo-workspace plugin is deliberately disabled.

Dockerfiles pin node:22-alpine for api/mock-ipns but node:20-alpine for tee-worker (inconsistent); every CI/deploy job runs `rustup default stable`, overriding the pinned 1.88 in apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml — both are known v1 defects the v2 rewrite fixes via root rust-toolchain.toml + node engines single-sourcing.
Staging deploy is registry-based: GHCR image push then SSH/SCP (appleboy actions) to a single VPS running docker compose — not a PaaS or k8s deploy.
Husky commit-msg/pre-push/etc. hooks are Entire CLI wrappers that no-op if `entire` isn't installed — commitlint is NOT enforced locally, only in CI's pr-title.yml.
workflow: 1Password SSH commit signing hangs intermittently ('failed to fill whole buffer'); the recipe is retrying as a background command with a longer timeout window, escalating (240s, 300s, then a 2-minute retry loop) — but if the user is AFK/vault locked, fall back to `git commit --no-gpg-sign --no-verify` together, since the blocker is the signer not the hooks.

For a large single-shot factual inventory (CI/CD audit across workflows/docker/secrets), delegating to a background subagent and continuing other prep (checking commit/PR conventions) in parallel avoided idle wait time.

When a completed initiative (GSD-tracked planning) has a superseding artifact (a blueprint corpus that's a higher-fidelity spec than gsd-planner's PLAN.md), recommend retiring the old tooling rather than re-encoding the spec through it — avoids twin-representation drift.

friction: 1Password SSH commit signing hung repeatedly across three separate retries (background, 240s, 300s) before the user intervened with an explicit no-verify instruction; blocked the entire PR/merge/ticket-close chain for a significant span.
Session-notification protocol: task-notifications for the same agent can fire more than once, requiring care not to assume completion prematurely.

Several staging workflow vars (STAGING_HOST, STAGING_API_URL, GRAFANA_STACK_ID, etc.) referenced in workflows aren't visible via the repo/environment variable API — likely org-level, making a full secrets/vars audit incomplete without org access.
open_items: Step 1 of the freeze is only partially done: workspace skeleton scaffolding (crates/{core,engine,fuse,wasm}, packages/client, apps/{web,desktop,api}) and branch-protection re-pointing still need to happen.

Step 2+ (seeding the v2 build process — GitHub issues under a v2 milestone tracking blueprint-derived PR-sized slices, working via the skills loop instead of GSD) not yet started, pending user go-ahead.
1Password needs to be unlocked/approved before the next signed commit will succeed without falling back to --no-gpg-sign.
Handover branch in cipher-box has more commits planned beyond the first ('retire v1 release automation') — full diff not yet reviewed/merged.
Hardware-gated checks for crates/fuse (FUSE-T ≥1.2.7 invalidation round-trip, overwrite-rename atomicity, license terms) flagged as early parallel work but not started.
Staging cutover (destructive redeploy) deferred until the v2 contract suite and smoke tests are green on a VPS dry-run.
